ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between a dominant low-intensity (black) field and discrete high-intensity (white) focal features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black region covering the majority of the fluke surface. High-intensity white pixels are organized into circular annular shapes and point-clusters distributed across both lobes, with significant concentrations at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior angle at the point of convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning into high-amplitude irregular jagged formations at the distal extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed circular and ring-like high-intensity pixel clusters across the ventral surface, suggesting extensive barnacle attachment scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical high-intensity linear marks: one approximately 1/3 across the left lobe and a more prominent vertical line 2/3 across the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular high-intensity white textural clusters and jagged morphology localized at the extreme distal points of both the left and right lobes.
